title: HEALING PRAYER
ISAIAH 40:29-31
end: The Healing Balm — receive God's healing peace

scenes.a: Bring your tired body and overburdened mind before the everlasting God who never grows weary.
Isaiah forty verse twenty-nine declares, He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles.
They shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk step by step, and not faint.
Father, exchange our exhaustion for Your sustaining grace and quiet every anxious thought.
Strengthen every recovering loved one, caregiver, and physician beneath Your gentle hand.
Type Amen and subscribe to The Healing Balm to receive God's healing peace in daily prayer.
